description: Place several files at once (File > Place with multiple files), laid out in a grid from x, y on an artboard, linked or embedded. Photoshop files take the Photoshop Import Options: convert layers to objects (needs embed), import hidden layers, slices, image maps and a layer comp; Illustrator's own options are restored afterwards

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

columns.description: Files per row. Default: all in one row

embed.description: Embed instead of linking. Default false

files.description: Absolute paths, placed in this order

gap.description: Space between files in points. Default 10

layerComp.description: Name of the layer comp to import

layersToObjects.description: Convert Layers to Objects (true) or flatten to a single image (false). Needs embed

width.description: Scale each file proportionally to this width in points

name: place_images
title: Place Images
